response.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_tg, AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5;

assumptions.assumption: The averages are taken over individual Laboratory rows (records), not per patient. NULL TG values are skipped by AVG, which satisfies 'ignore missing values'. Rows with NULL WBC are excluded by the WBC >= 6.5 filter.
